newsitem.title: UK: Russian aluminium exports may ease as demand rises.
newsitem.headline: Russian aluminium exports may ease as demand rises.

text.p: Exports of primary aluminium from the former Soviet Union could ease in coming years if Russian domestic demand increases, Paul Everard, Executive Director of Gencor Aluminium BV said.
"The worst is behind us now with net exports at plus or minus two million tonnes (a year). That has been absorbed into the West now," Everard said at the Financial Times World Aluminium Conference.
There are signs now, although these are difficult to quantify, that demand in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) may start to turn up. If so, exports may decline, he said.
